title: The live-stream guard allows the Monitor tool and names it in its remedy
why: Lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm (session_013NEJL232Ko7dmr4v3fmrvF), from the round-2 review of #2226, 13:29 CST Nov 8: the live-stream rule in hooks/guard.py (~line 3729) refuses the Monitor tool's own first example, `tail -f <log> | grep --line-buffered ERROR`, and its remedy never names Monitor. Main does the same. Step waiter-remedy-monitor-refused covers the waiter guard, not this rule.
